summary: Brief Check not met: 'every recipe except live is run once locally and the result recorded in evidence'. The only implementer evidence for this chore is the nextest junit report (target/0-32-changelog-junit.xml, 434 records + 63 per-test records); no record or commit message states a run of release-check, lint, gate, docs, conformance, launcher, platformer, dashboard, man or bench, and no note says live/bench were not run (live needs docker; bench reads /proc so is Linux-only). Reviewer re-ran on HEAD: release-check OK (12 tests), lint OK, docs no diff, gate red only on unreviewed-promotion, launcher 5 pass, dashboard build OK; platformer fails on this machine (Node 26: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading clear)' from localStorage in the tests, not from the justfile or this change; CI pins its own toolchain); man, bench, conformance, live not run by me. Implementer should add the recipe-run results (and the not-run reasons) to the evidence. Blast radius: the recipes are not exercised by CI, so a wrong flag in an unrun recipe goes unnoticed until a contributor hits it.
